"## Structural Engineer

## Position Overview

We are looking for a highly skilled and motivated Structural Engineer to join our team and contribute to the design, analysis, and delivery of a diverse range of construction and infrastructure projects. The ideal candidate will bring strong technical expertise, a commitment to structural integrity, and the ability to collaborate effectively across multidisciplinary teams. This role suits an experienced engineer who thrives in a dynamic environment and is passionate about delivering safe, innovative, and cost-effective structural solutions.

## Key Responsibilities

- Analyse structural systems for both static and dynamic loading conditions, ensuring all designs meet relevant Australian standards and codes of practice
- Determine appropriate construction methods, materials, and quality standards, and develop detailed specifications, drawings, and construction procedures to guide project delivery
- Design structures across a range of typologies to ensure they perform safely and do not collapse, deflect excessively, or behave in any undesirable manner under load
- Prepare and review engineering drawings, reports, and documentation in support of development approvals, construction certificates, and project handover
- Conduct site inspections and supervise construction activities to verify works are being carried out in accordance with approved designs and specifications
- Assess and evaluate the behaviour and durability of construction materials, recommending suitable options based on project requirements and site conditions
- Collaborate with architects, civil engineers, project managers, and other stakeholders to develop integrated structural solutions from concept through to completion
- Identify and manage structural risks throughout the project lifecycle, providing practical engineering solutions to resolve design and construction challenges
- Prepare and review structural calculations, geotechnical reports, and material testing data to inform and validate design decisions
- Contribute to the mentoring and technical development of graduate and junior engineers within the team
- Liaise with clients, contractors, and regulatory authorities to ensure projects are delivered on time, within budget, and to the required quality standards

## Required Qualifications & Skills

- Bachelor's degree or higher in Structural Engineering, Civil Engineering, or a related discipline
- Registered or eligible for registration as a Professional Engineer in the relevant Australian state or territory
- Demonstrated experience in structural engineering design across commercial, residential, or infrastructure projects
- Proficiency in structural analysis and modelling software such as ETABS, SAP2000, SPACE GASS, Strand7, or similar
- Sound knowledge of Australian Standards and the National Construction Code (NCC)
- Strong ability to prepare, interpret, and review engineering drawings, specifications, and technical reports
- Excellent problem-solving skills with the ability to deliver practical and innovative structural solutions
- Effective communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to engage confidently with clients, contractors, and multidisciplinary teams
- Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously
- Full working rights in Australia

## Preferred Qualifications

- Membership with Engineers Australia (MIEAust) or Chartered Professional Engineer (CPEng) status, or working towards chartership
- Experience with Building Information Modelling (BIM) platforms such as Revit Structure
- Familiarity with sustainable design principles and experience delivering projects with a focus on environmental performance
- Postgraduate qualifications or specialist training in structural or geotechnical engineering
- Experience working on mixed-use, high-rise, or large-scale infrastructure projects
- Exposure to project management frameworks and familiarity with construction contract administration

## Why Join Us?

- Work on a varied and challenging portfolio of projects spanning commercial, residential, and infrastructure sectors, with genuine opportunities to advance your career
- Flexible working arrangements available, including hybrid options, to support a healthy work-life balance
- Ongoing investment in your professional development, including support for CPEng chartership, training programmes, and industry memberships
- Be part of a collaborative, inclusive team culture that values innovation, technical excellence, and mutual respect
- Competitive remuneration package with annual salary reviews and access to performance-based incentives

## Job Details

- Job Type: Full-time, Permanent
- Work Schedule: 8-hour shift
- Salary: $70,000 – $120,000 per year + Superannuation"

ABOUT THE COMPANY
Mayfly Ventures Pty Ltd is a venture studio founded in 2022 and based in Melbourne, Victoria, specialising in building vertical SaaS and AI ventures. The team comprises engineers, designers, and venture builders who partner with industry experts to design, build, and launch disruptive technology products. Mayfly's core capabilities span venture building, solution design (UX/UI design, UX research, business process mapping, and product strategy), and full product development including MVP delivery, AI agent development, mobile applications, and SaaS platforms.

The studio works with both established businesses and growth-stage startups, specialising in rapidprototyping and iterative product development to help clients achieve product-market fit and reduce the technical barriers between idea and execution.

ABOUT THE ROLE
Mayfly Ventures is seeking an experienced Developer Programmer to join our team on a full-time basis. This is a hands-on, end-to-end product delivery role in which you will architect, design, build, and maintain web and mobile applications across concurrent client and in-house venture projects.
You will work closely with founders, stakeholders, and cross-functional teams to translate requirements into high-quality, scalable software solutions, leveraging modern no-code platforms, AI tooling, and best-practice software development methods.

KEY DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES
• Lead end-to-end design and development of web and mobile applications, managing priorities, timelines, and delivery across multiple concurrent projects
• Analyse user requirements and translate them into software specifications, user flows, information architecture, and technical design decisions
• Architect scalable, performant application structures including database design, backend workflow logic, and API integration strategies
• Design and develop responsive, high-fidelity user interfaces applying UI/UX design principles to maximise usability, engagement, and product quality
• Build and maintain integrations with third-party APIs and external services to extend
application functionality

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS AND SKILLS
Candidates must demonstrate the following:
• Bachelor’s degree or higher in a relevant field such as Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or equivalent
• Minimum 5 years of proven experience as a Developer Programmer, Software Developer, or equivalent, with a strong portfolio of delivered software projects
• Proficiency in no-code application development, particularly Bubble.io, with demonstrated ability to build complex, production-grade web and mobile applications
• Solid understanding of database design, data modelling, relational structures, and backend workflow logic
• Demonstrated experience integrating REST APIs and third-party services into production application environments
• Strong UI/UX design capability including wireframing, prototyping, and high-fidelity interface design using tools such as Figma
• Working knowledge of HTML and CSS for front-end customisation and interface optimisation
• Experience applying Agile methodologies and using project management tools such as ClickUp, Jira, Asana, or Trello
• Excellent analytical thinking and problem-solving skills with strong attention to detail and system-level thinking
• Effective communication and stakeholder management abilities, with capacity to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced delivery environment

DESIRABLE ATTRIBUTES
• Experience designing and deploying AI-integrated product features and agentic or automated decision workflows
• Familiarity with additional platforms and tools such as Cursor, Bubble, Xano, and AI
• Experience with payment infrastructure integration (e.g. Stripe Connect) and end-to-end monetisation flow design
• Experience leading small development or design teams across concurrent client-facing delivery engagements
• Experience working across multiple industries including fintech, health, education, logistics, or hospitality technology sectors

HOW TO APPLY
Interested candidates should submit a current resume, a cover letter addressing the key
selection criteria, and examples of relevant projects or a portfolio link to careers@mayflyventures.com

result.description:
About Us
Simmonds Steel is a leading structural steel supplier and fabricator servicing residential, commercial, industrial and mining projects throughout Western Australia. We provide structural steel solutions ranging from small residential applications to large-scale commercial and industrial developments, including design support, 3D modelling, fabrication and installation services.
We are seeking an experienced and motivated Construction Estimator to join our team on a full-time basis.
Position Overview
Responsible for preparing accurate cost estimates and tender submissions for structural steel fabrication and installation projects. The role involves analysing engineering and architectural documentation, calculating material and labour requirements, obtaining supplier and subcontractor pricing, and supporting project delivery through effective cost planning and estimating. Involvement in tender settlement, cost planning, supplier negotiations, and project budget forecasting
Key Duties and Responsibilities
•	Review and interpret structural, architectural and engineering drawings, specifications and tender documentation.
•	Perform detailed quantity take-offs for structural steel components, including beams, columns, lintels, bracing systems, platework and associated materials.
•	Calculate project costs, including materials, fabrication, labour, transport, craneage, installation and subcontractor services.
•	Prepare accurate cost estimates, quotations, budgets and tender submissions for residential, commercial, industrial and mining projects.
•	Liaise with engineers, architects, project managers, clients and contractors to clarify project requirements and specifications.
•	Assess project risks, site conditions and construction methodologies affecting project costs and delivery.
•	Prepare and maintain estimating databases, cost records and pricing schedules.
•	Assist management in tender reviews, contract negotiations and project handovers.
•	Monitor market pricing trends for steel products, fabrication processes and construction services.
•	Support project planning by providing cost forecasts, material schedules and estimating reports.
•	Ensure all estimates comply with relevant Australian Standards, building codes, safety requirements and company procedures.
Skills and Experience
•	Diploma, Advanced Diploma or higher qualification in Building, Construction, Engineering or a related discipline.
•	Minimum 3 years’ relevant experience as a Construction Estimator, Steel Estimator, Building Estimator or similar role.
•	Strong ability to read and interpret structural and engineering drawings.
•	Experience estimating structural steel fabrication and installation projects.
•	Sound knowledge of construction methods, steel products and fabrication processes.
•	Proficiency with estimating software, Microsoft Excel and construction management systems.
•	Ability to manage multiple tenders and meet deadlines.
What We Offer
•	Full-time permanent position.
•	Competitive salary package of $90000.00 per annum plus superannuation
•	Supportive and professional working environment.
•	Career growth within an established structural steel business.
If you have the skills and experience to contribute to our growing team, we encourage you to apply.
